messages:
jess_cs: FYI — HelixCorp dedicated pool activation tomorrow 07:00 PT. Need final quota, autoscale policy, and a short runbook for their SREs. Renewal check: they expect zero 5xx for first 6 hours.
omar_infra: Pool provisioned. Reserved GPUs = 8xA100, quota set to 300k tokens/min by default. We can temporarily raise to 450k tokens/min for the first 12h.
ritika_se: Customer demand pattern: large bursts ~200r/s for 30s every 5 min. Suggest burst-aware autoscale and aggressive prefix caching.
sam_ops: Can we sketch an acceptance plan with pass/fail criteria? Want to avoid last-minute escalation to AMs.
jess_cs: Pass criteria suggestion: p95 < 220ms, error < 0.3%, no sustained GPU OOMs, kv_hit_ratio >= 0.35 after priming. Fail -> rollback.
omar_infra: Autoscale policy I'd apply:
```json
{"target_util":0.7,"max_multiplier":3,"scale_window_s":180,"min_instances":2}
```
This gives headroom for brief spikes.
ritika_se: For the loadtest, we'll run two phases: priming (low rps with X-Helix-Priming header) then burst cycles to mimic production. k6 snippet:```bash
k6 run --vus 500 --duration 20m --rps 1200 load_burst.js
```
Add header: {"X-Helix-Priming":"true"}.
sam_ops: Who's owning monitoring during the run? I can watch infra alerts and relay to client SRE. Need traces for slow requests.
omar_infra: I'll enable verbose runtime tracing for 15m windows and keep a 1m retention for the trace ids we tag. Also soft quota mode for first 2h (429 with retry-after header).
jess_cs: Nice. Also include a short note for the customer's SREs about interpreting throttles vs real errors — I'll draft that.
ritika_se: If latency slips, fallback order: 1) enable q4f16 fallback, 2) reduce max context to 4k, 3) lower batch size. We should capture quality diffs before flip.
omar_infra: Sample rollout timeline:
- 07:00 PT: Enable reserved pool, route 5% canary
- 07:20 PT: Run burst loadtest (internal)
- 07:40 PT: Increase to 30% if metrics within pass
- 08:20 PT: Full traffic if stable
- 10:00 PT: Lower soft-throttle -> hard enforcement off

sam_ops: Monitoring checklist: p95, p99, 5xx rate, kv_hit_ratio, gpu_mem_free, token_throughput. Alert thresholds: p95 > 300ms for 2m -> page eng-runtime.
ritika_se: I'll prepare a 500-sample eval run comparing baseline vs q4f16 and post a short diff report by 04:00 PT.
jess_cs: Good. Also capture enablement feedback: client asked for a one-page explainer on autoscale behavior + examples of when it triggers. I'll attach it to the timeline.
omar_infra: Dry run logs (snippet):
```
[06:58:12] loadgen: burst_rps=1180, errors=1 (0.08%), p95=212ms
[07:05:00] runtime: kv_hit=0.39, gpu_util=65%, mem_free=12.1GB
```
Looks within tolerance for canary.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled for 2024-03-18T07:00:00-07:00. Playbook -> https://redwood.internal/playbooks/dedicated-activation
jess_cs: Next actions: Omar to apply autoscale JSON at 06:50 PT, Ritika to publish eval diffs by 04:00 PT, Sam to own monitoring and paging. I'll send the customer timeline and runbook by EOD today. :rocket:
omar_infra: Will do. I'll also add a temporary alert mute for noisy infra alerts during the 30m ramp window.
sam_ops: I'll prepare a single Slack channel bridge with the customer's SREs and post links to dashboards.
jess_cs: Thanks team — tag me if anything unexpected, otherwise I'll confirm after canary. :thumbsup:
